With bounty hunting in full force in the SW:CCG universe, [[Myo]] is a support card that cannot be ignored. One of the prime drawbacks of the bounty hunting "scum and villany" is their lack of adequate forefeit value. Sometimes I think it would be nice if there was something to make up for this disablity. But wait! There is, and it came out with the Premiere edition of SW:CCG.

[[Myo]] is a healthy 3 desitiny, 3 power, 1 ability warrior. But when you look more carefully, there is a bit more.... [[Myo]]'s forefeit is 5, putting him on par with such attrition favorites as [[Officer Evax]] and [[Admiral Ozzel]]. Also, [[Myo]] gets a boost in power when he is present with any bounty hunter (4 deploy for 4 power isn't great but not bad either). Finally, [[Myo]] REGENERATES! When he is lost as a result of battle (including weapons fire) he goes to your Used Pile.

So [[Myo]] is a natural with bounty hunters, but be aware of a few drawbacks. His ability 1 makes him a prime target for weapons fire (especially sabers which may drop his forefeit to 0). Obi Wan (and those with his cape) loves messing with [[Myo]]'s mind and can easily send him away from the battle where he was needed. Finally, his deploy cost of 4 makes him difficult to get out of your hand.

Used wisely, however, [[Myo]] can give you a critical advantage, especially in the prolonged struggles for [[Tatooine (Dark){{!}}Tatooine]] and Cloud City.

Card Combos:

[[Myo]] + [[Bounty]] Hunters = Protect your low forefeit bounty hunters by throwing [[Myo]] in the way.

[[Myo]] + [[Lone Warrior]] + Moment of Triumph = You only lose the destiny adders, get to keep the character, and can take down [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]] or Obi by himself.
|combos=* [[Myo]] + [[Bounty]] Hunters = Protect your low forefeit bounty hunters by throwing [[Myo]] in the way.<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Myo</ref>
